items.title: Murdoch University Singapore Scholarships
eligibility: Apply for an eligible Murdoch University programme offered in Singapore
Meet the admission requirements of the chosen programme
Submit a complete scholarship application with supporting documents
Demonstrate suitability for the selected scholarship category
quotes: Murdoch University, in partnership with Kaplan Higher Education Academy, is offering 20 scholarships for eligible students pursuing a Murdoch programme in Singapore.
Apply for an eligible Murdoch University programme offered in Singapore
Meet the admission requirements of the chosen programme
Submit a complete scholarship application with supporting documents
Demonstrate suitability for the selected scholarship category
Meeting the eligibility requirements does not guarantee the award of a scholarship.

items.title: Kaplan scholarship for continuing students
items.value: S$10,000 / S$7,500 / S$5,000 for the top three, set against the degree’s fees
eligibility: At least 90% attendance in every module
Pass every exam at the first attempt
An average of 85 or more across modules
Continue from a Kaplan diploma to a partner university’s bachelor’s degree (or from the bachelor’s to its master’s)
quotes: 所有课程的出勤率必须达到90%或以上
所有课程考试必须一次通过
所有课程平均分数达到85分
